question: Since Re: Zero is a fantasy world, you can easily make up and use spell names and really cool nicknames, but what are the names of spells or people’s nicknames that the author particularly likes?
answer: Looks like it would burn with a ‘goa’ sound -> ‘Goa’. Looks like it would freeze with a ‘hyuma’ sound -> ‘Huma’. Looks like it would blow away with a ‘fura’ sound -> ‘Fura’. The feel of the sound lines up, so earth is fine with ‘Dona’...... Darkness is blinding, so ‘shakohkahten’ (note: shading curtain, with curtain taken from the English word) -> ‘shakohmaku’ (note: shading curtain) -> ‘shamaku’ -> ‘Shamac’ is good, I guess…… It’s that kind of approach, so I’m really sorry in regards to magic. I hadn’t really intended to use my head enough to make it interesting. I feel like I haven’t used many nicknames, either, aside from “Sword Demon”, “Master Swordsman”, and “Clown”. Here, too, I didn’t really use my head enough to make it interesting. Please don’t expect anything from me besides things around the story itself. I’ve got some ideas there.
